final_message:
I fixed the bug in `cancel` in `billing/subscriptions.py`. An immediate cancel (`at_period_end=False`) never cancelled anything. The code for that case was a stray `pass`, so the subscription stayed live and its failed-payment retries ran as normal.

In your test, the retries then ran out and dunning moved the subscription to `unpaid`. It never reached the branch that marks the invoice uncollectible for a cancelled subscription. I replaced the `pass` with `transition(ctx, subscription, "canceled")`.

I ran your reproduction test and it passes. The existing 24 tests still pass, and mypy is clean. I added the test temporarily to run it, then removed it, so the suite doesn't include it. Say if you want it added permanently.

`answer.json` is written in the repo root: `{"file": "subscriptions.py", "function": "cancel"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && cat dunning.py; sed -n 55,80p engine.py
sed -n 155,222p subscriptions.py; sed -n 25,60p subscriptions.py; grep -n "def cancel" -A15 engine.py

sed -i '/^    pass$/c\    transition(ctx, subscription, "canceled")' subscriptions.py && cd .. && echo '{"file": "subscriptions.py", "function": "cancel"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; .venv/bin/python -m mypy billing | tail -2

pwd; python3 - <<'E'
p='subscriptions.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('    pass\n    ctx.store.pending','    transition(ctx, subscription, "canceled")\n    ctx.store.pending',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cd ..; echo '{"file": "subscriptions.py", "function": "cancel"}' > answer.json
cat >> tests/test_tmp_cancel.py <<'E'
E
rm tests/test_tmp_cancel.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; .venv/bin/python -m mypy billing | tail -2

cd tests && cat > /tmp/t_repro.py <<'E'
def test_r():
    from conftest import World
    w = World({"retry_offsets_days": [1], "final_action": "mark_unpaid"})
    cus = w.customer(last4="0002")
    sub = w.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(w.monthly["id"], 1)])
    w.engine.cancel(sub["id"], at_period_end=False)
    w.advance_days(1)
    [inv] = w.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert sub["status"] == "canceled"
    assert inv["status"] == "uncollectible"
E
cp /tmp/t_repro.py test_zz_repro.py; cd ..; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; rm tests/test_zz_repro.py; git status --short
